messages.author: c0e941a784f9e7dc
messages.subject: ggtree change group colors
parts:
Hi Guangchuang,

May I ask that how to manually change the color for each group of species in my ggtree? currently the automatically generated tree set archaea to red, bacteria to green and eukaryota to blue, but for in accordance with my previous plots, I want to set bacteria into red, eukaryota into green and archaea into blue. The following is my current code, can you please give me some advice on how to change the color setting? I also attached my plot to this email. Thank you so much for the help.

pdf(file="4.pdf", width=15, height=15)
ggtree(tree4, aes(color=group), layout='circular') + geom_tiplab(size=1, aes(angle=angle))+ theme(legend.position = "bottom") + ggtitle("Phylogenetic Tree of Protein H4")
+ scale_color_manual(values=c("blue", "green","red"))
dev.off()




Best,
MH

messages.subject: Re: ggtree change group colors
parts:
you already know how to do this using scale_color_manual.

Please refer to the second example on http://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/scale_manual.html by using named vector.

​
